lines.zh: 我拖着步子走，脚踝上挂着骨环。
lines.en: I drag my steps, bone rings at my ankles.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可我不停下来。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and I don't stop.
I follow the lie of the dead grass.
I lurch forward, pause, lurch again.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都干了。
lines.en: The grass dries where I've walked.
I circle that ring of stones.
I pass a puddle and it goes muddy.

lines.zh: 我停下来听了一会儿，又走。
lines.en: I stop, listen, and walk on.
I pull one foot out of the soil.
I walk toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下浅坑。
lines.en: Shallow pits follow me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，又低下。
lines.en: I look up at the sky, then down again.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在皮下凸出来。
lines.en: My ribs stand out under the skin.
I'm in no hurry; the road is long.
I stand and wait without moving.

lines.zh: 我的关节很硬，弯着不动。
lines.en: My joints lock and stay bent.

lines.zh: 四周的草在往我这边倒。
lines.en: The grass around leans toward me.
I'm listening to the sound in the soil.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙很干，咽不下去。
lines.en: My throat is dry; I can't swallow.

lines.zh: 我侧过脸，听地底的动静。
lines.en: I turn my cheek to listen to the ground below.

lines.zh: 这一带已经没有活的东西了。
lines.en: Nothing living is left in this stretch.
I stand in place, unmoving for a long time.

lines.zh: 我好像听见有人在叫我。
lines.en: I think I hear someone calling.
I'm counting what's left.

lines.zh: 我身上的骨头互相碰了一下。
lines.en: My bones knock together.
The quiet here makes me hungry.
I stand as if waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 我闻到你皮肤上的盐味。
lines.en: I smell the salt on your skin.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把你看了一遍。
lines.en: I raise my head and look you over.
I haven't seen anything living in a long while.
You're closer now; I smell blood.
Why are you still standing there.
I lift one hand, slowly.

lines.zh: 你能听见土地在叫我吗。
lines.en: Can you hear the soil calling me.
I've been hungry a very long time.
You shouldn't have taken this road.
I give half a step and my bones click.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的脚步。
lines.en: The blow breaks my rhythm.
I touch the split in my side.
I don't cry out; I lower my head.
Soil falls off me.
I brace on my knee and stand.
My wound is slowly closing.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看你还在不在。
lines.en: I look up to see if you're still there.
I straighten and move forward again.

lines.zh: 那东西在地上，我闻到了。
lines.en: It's on the ground; I smell it.
I bend down, slowly.
I snatch it up and shove it in my mouth.
This isn't enough — nowhere near.
I chew a long time before swallowing.
You set it down and step back.
I crouch and shield it with my hands.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出一点声音。
lines.en: A small sound comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起来一点事。
lines.en: This taste brings something back.
Give me the whole bag.

lines.zh: 我把手指上的渣舔干净了。
lines.en: I lick the crumbs off my fingers.

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候我不看你。
lines.en: I don't look at you while I eat.
This is better than I remember.
I rise slowly; still not full.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: You hit me and a bone clicks.
My shoulder jabs you.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我身上一点土。
lines.en: The bump knocks some soil off me.
I don't dodge; I only stop.
You're knocked back two paces.
I turn my head and look at you slowly.
I put a hand out to steady you.
I can take that much.
She walks this road too.
Her bones show more than mine.
We lower our heads together.

lines.zh: 她把手放在我肩上，很冷。
lines.en: She lays a cold hand on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 土地在我们脚下动了动。
lines.en: The soil shifts under us.
I've never heard her voice before.

lines.zh: 然后她走开了，往更深处。
lines.en: Then she walks off, deeper in.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，看着她消失。
lines.en: I stand and watch her vanish.

lines.zh: 我用两只手把它捧起来。
lines.en: I lift it in both hands.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，石头一样硬。
lines.en: I bite it; it's hard as stone.
It's dirty; I don't care.

lines.zh: 我捏着它，指节一格一格动。
lines.en: I pinch it, my knuckles clicking one joint at a time.
It isn't food; I drop it.

lines.zh: 我搂住它，像搂住一块干粮。
lines.en: I clutch it like a piece of hardtack.
I dig it out of the soil.
I lick it; the taste is old.

lines.zh: 我把它带在身上，慢慢走。
lines.en: I carry it and walk on.
I heard it; I won't wait anymore.
The soil tells me where you are.
I lift a foot and walk your way.
The soil where you stand is soft.
I don't run; I'll walk there.
When I wake, I call your name.
I won't let you leave again.
I have woken, and I am walking toward you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着，不加快。
lines.en: I follow step by step, never speeding up.
The soil softens under your feet.
You look back and I'm still there.
I reach out a hand, very long.
The more you run, the slower you get.
I'm only a few paces away.
You've backed into the ring of stones.
A few steps left; I'm in no rush.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，抓住你的手腕。
lines.en: I reach out and take your wrist.

lines.zh: 我的手指很凉，扣得很紧。
lines.en: My fingers are cold and they close hard.
I push you down into the soil.
I bite; my teeth are blunt.
You kick; I don't let go.
My bones press your back.

lines.zh: 土地把我们的脚都咬住了。
lines.en: The soil grips both our feet.
You've stopped struggling.

lines.zh: 这一顿吃下去，能撑很久。
lines.en: This meal will last me a long while.
A patch of soil swells first.
I sit up out of the soil.
The dead grass lies away from me.

lines.zh: 我的骨头先露出来，然后是皮。
lines.en: Bones show first, then skin.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出第一个声音。
lines.en: The first sound leaves my throat.
The soil moves; it welcomes me.
Everything around goes quiet.
I walk toward the nearest sound.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进土里，又拔出来。
lines.en: My foot sinks and comes free.
I'm as hungry as this ground.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的皮，干得裂开。
lines.en: Fire sears my skin until it cracks.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，骨头磕在地上。
lines.en: I fall and my bones hit the ground.
Water floods my throat; I claw at the mud.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀出去，摔进土里。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the soil.

lines.zh: 一根尖物插进我的肋骨间。
lines.en: Something sharp lodges between my ribs.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的骨头缩了一下。
lines.en: That light makes my bones shrink.

lines.zh: 我本来就饿，现在更站不住。
lines.en: I was hungry before; now I can't stand.
Lightning strikes and smoke rises off me.

lines.zh: 下面没有土，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: No soil below; I keep falling.
